rounds.summary: Docs-only change to agent guidance. The git behavior it relies on was reproduced in a scratch repo, but no lead agent was run against the new text.

findings.description: live validation verdict: inconclusive (2 of 3 scenarios were driven live against the product); untested: A lead agent given the new step-4 text keeps all writer branches when detached and names them in its reply

rounds.summary: The change adds one prose sentence to a delegation guidance document. It has no executable surface, and I could not drive the lead-agent behavior it guides live in this run.

findings.description: live validation verdict: inconclusive (1 of 3 scenarios were driven live against the product); untested: A detached lead given the new step-4 text keeps every writer branch and names it in its reply, An attached lead still deletes merged fast-forward and merge-commit branches under the new text
